df7040c9ca57a59a.description: Aperture Tours , an international photography tour company, is seeking skilled professional photographers to lead private photography tours in Istanbul . About the role We host private photography tours in cities around the world. Our clients range from complete beginners who have just taken their camera out of the box to experienced amateur and semi-professional photographers looking to discover the best places to photograph a city. Most of our guests are aged between 40 and 60, and our largest markets are the United States, Canada and Australia. They come from all over the world, but they all share one thing: a genuine passion for photography. As their guide, you will introduce them to your city through photography, help them get better images from their camera, show them the best locations and provide practical advice on technique, composition and settings.
